Together referred to as the "Parties."

1. Scope of Services

The Warehouse agrees to receive, handle, and store Customer's goods ("Goods") at its facility located at {% if company_address %} {{ company_address.address_line1 or "" }} {%- if company_address.city %}, {{ company_address.city }}{% endif -%} . {% else %} [Facility Address Not Found]. {% endif %}

Services include unloading, storage, handling, inventory reporting, and re-delivery. Additional services (e.g., repacking, labeling, kitting) may be provided upon written request and subject to additional fees.

2. Term and Renewal

This Agreement shall be effective for {{ doc.term or "[one (1) year]" }} commencing on {{ doc.get_formatted("date") }} (and valid until {{ doc.get_formatted("valid_until") }}) and may be renewed upon mutual written agreement.

3. Obligations of Warehouse

The Warehouse shall:

  • Exercise reasonable care in handling and storing Goods in accordance with Philippine Civil Code provisions.
  • Maintain facilities in compliance with safety, fire, and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain fire and other perils insurance on its premises, but not on individual Goods unless separately agreed.

4. Obligations of Customer

The Customer shall:

  • Provide accurate and complete documentation of Goods.
  • Ensure that Goods are properly packed and comply with labeling and regulatory requirements.
  • Pay all storage, handling, and service fees on time.
  • Provide valuation of Goods, get insurance.

5. Fees and Payment

All amounts are exclusive of 12% VAT and applicable Philippine taxes.

Warehouse standard operating hours are:
Mon – Friday: 7am – 5pm
Saturday: 7am – 12nn

Any services rendered beyond standard operating hours, on Sundays, or on legal holidays shall be subject to overtime and holiday charges as set forth in the applicable Rate Matrix.

6. Liability and Insurance

The Warehouse's liability for loss or damage shall not exceed the agreed valuation of the Goods, or if no valuation is agreed, the lower of: (i) the declared value of Goods; or (ii) [X pesos] per package or [X pesos] per CBM. The Warehouse is not an insurer of the Goods.

The Warehouse shall not be liable for losses arising from force majeure, inherent defects, poor packing, infestation, mold, natural shrinkage, obsolescence, or regulatory seizures.

Indirect or consequential damages are expressly excluded.

7. Lien Rights

The Warehouse shall have a lien on all Goods stored for unpaid charges and may sell such Goods in accordance with applicable Philippine law if fees remain unpaid after receipt of Notice of Lien, or [other condition if not able to receive notice].

8. Termination

Either Party may terminate this Agreement for cause upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

Either Party may also terminate without cause with ninety (90) days' written notice.

The Warehouse reserves the right to immediately remove or dispose of Goods that pose an imminent hazard, are illegal, or subject to regulatory seizure.

Upon termination, the Customer shall first settle all outstanding balances and obligations to the Warehouse.

Only after such settlement may the Customer remove its Goods from the Warehouse.

9. Force Majeure

Neither Party shall be liable for delays or failures due to acts of nature, war, strikes, floods, or other circumstances beyond reasonable control.

10. Confidentiality

Both Parties agree to maintain confidentiality of all storage records, client data, and related business information.

11. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.

Venue for any disputes shall be the proper courts of {{ doc.venue_city or "[City/Province]" }}.

12. Miscellaneous

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both Parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement on the date and place first above written.
